unit: the operative sentence(s) of the clause that contain the amended words

covers: prohibition (shall not, no person shall, prohibited)
modality.why: whether conduct is required, allowed or forbidden is the core of a legal instruction

covers: amounts in rupees, thousand, lakh, crore with their limit (up to, at least, fixed)
monetary_threshold.why: changes when the rule bites or how much is at stake

covers: frequencies (annually, once in every N years)

exception.why: changes who or what escapes the rule

covers: a named person or body before the modal verb
actor.why: who must act; low weight because the extractor is a heuristic

covers: the words after the modal verb
action.why: what must be done; low weight because the extractor is a heuristic

score: sum of the weights of fields whose operation is ADDED, REMOVED or CHANGED (0-100). Fields marked UNCERTAIN are excluded and reported; the score is then a lower bound.
llm_proposals: optional; a proposed field value is used only if it validates against the schema and is a verbatim substring of the cited clause; otherwise it is discarded and the deterministic result stands
abstain_when: the clause fails the text-quality gate
changes_from_v1: actor only when the subject names a person or body (government, authority, court, officer, person, party, company, ...); provisos and 'it is hereby declared' lead-ins are stripped
action only for an accepted actor
no score (state INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, label 'Not scored', reason UNSUPPORTED_RULE_FIELD) when operative wording changed but no supported field captures it; v1 reported 0 as a lower bound
